invariants.rationale: The method returns immediately if projectFilePath is null or empty, so if we reach the exit, this holds.
resolve(projectFilePath) is called after null/empty check, so it should succeed if method did not return earlier.
If projectFilePath is not null or empty, we return early if propertyTypes is null, so at exit this cannot happen.
If propertyTypes exists, at least one member is iterated after skipping empty ones.
